_about: the owner 2026-10-05: 'make sure that the bots are aware of the AQW birthday event and they claim the free acs'. One-time claims, run while their event is live (brain step 4, ahead of event wishes), once per version of the script: Skua rewrites the yearly free-AC script for each year's quest, and the new file is claimed again on its own. `until` = the day the quest goes rare. Two failed tries per version, then it waits for a new version. 2026-10-13: until is a day of the year ("11-01", with fromMonth) so the gifts recur every year; staleQuests = last year's quest ids (the script waits until Skua rewrites it for the new quest); Frostval Chilly's Participation makes the account eligible for the ACs players donate during Frostval.
